newsitem.title: USA: COMEX copper called to open firmer.
newsitem.headline: COMEX copper called to open firmer.

text.p: COMEX copper futures were called to open firmer Monday, although the LME backwardation dipped sharply overnight on heavy lending despite a sharp drop in LME stocks and news of a vote to strike at Quebrada Blanca.
The cash to three months LME backwardation was down $50 since Friday, at $140/$150.
COMEX July copper was called 0.30 to 0.70 cent firmer from Friday's finish of 110.95 cents a lb after trading from 111.55 to 110.25 cents on ACCESS.
LME warehouse copper stocks fell 3,400 tonnes Monday to 141,800 tonnes, while COMEX stocks rose 676 short tons Friday to 51,927 short tons.
In Chile, workers at Quebrada Blanca copper mine voted to go on strike, due to start first shift on Wednesday.
U.S. home sales for March, forecast at 794,000 compared to 811,000 in February, are due at 1000 EDT.
